selection: 14 distinct venue links in DOM order from the initial Climbing, Top Rated, and New on Resy sections. Each section displayed five entries; Esme appeared twice. No See more controls were followed.
procedure: Load agent-browser skills get core; derive an isolated session with agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix resy-discovery.
Open https://resy.com/cities/san-francisco-ca and wait until a venue link exists without undefined in its URL.
Run snapshot -i -u, then read-only eval over a[href*="/venues/"]. Extract innerText and href, excluding undefined and /events/ URLs. Strip query parameters, deduplicate, preserve DOM order.
Record UTC time and selected discovery sections; do not infer physical geography from city-page membership. Close only the owned session after the separate Esme pilot.
limitations: Bounded discovery, not a census or representative sample. Other sections still contained loading placeholders.
No addresses were visible in these discovery rows. Geography and booking eligibility remain unassessed here.
Rich Table was not present in this bounded inventory; this does not establish absence from Resy.
